description: This file defines internal static metrics instrumentation for application requests, including counters for timed out and canceled requests, and latency histograms. It interacts with a metrics instruments library to create and update metrics related to application request lifecycle events.

classes.name: ApplicationRequestInstruments
classes.description: Contains static methods and fields for tracking application request metrics such as timeouts, cancellations, and latency.

methods.name: OnAppRequestsEnd
methods.description: Records the latency of a completed application request.

methods.name: OnAppRequestsTimedOut
methods.description: Increments the counter for timed out requests.

methods.name: OnAppRequestsCanceled
methods.description: Increments the counter for canceled requests.
